name: Group Expense Splitter
description: Track who paid and who joined each expense, split to the exact cent, and get a balance-conserving transfer suggestion with an exportable report; fully offline
help: Create an activity and add member nicknames (duplicates are fine — members are identified by id); record each expense with title, date, total, payer and a split mode.
Splits support equal, shares and exact amounts; money is computed in integer cents with remainders assigned in a stable member order, so shares always sum to the total.

Exact amounts must add up to the total: explicit zeros are fine, missing or over-contributing entries are rejected; transfer suggestions are drafts only — balances change when you record actual settlements.
Activity data stays in the local ToolForge database; export CSV/JSON/text reports and duplicate members into a fresh activity at any time.

input.title: Title
input.empty: Add members first, then record expenses

result.title: Settlement
result.empty: Record an expense to see the settlement
result.netHint: positive = should receive, negative = should pay; the sum is always zero
result.transfersHint: Drafts to verify — balances only change when a settlement is recorded
